messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity - inference latency spike in us-west-2 for model "redwood-v1". AlertID INC-2026-3247. Trigger: p95 token latency > 2.5s. Paging @maria_chu (oncall)

maria chu: On it, joining bridge now. Any customer-facing hits?

jon p: Seeing increased 504s at the gateway, some requests retried and hit fallback model which shortened outputs. No billing-side error surge yet.

alisha r: Running node checks — lots of KV cache churn and mem pressure. Pulling dmesg and docker stats.

maria chu: Investigating autoscaler. It attempted scale up but we saw pods restart during that window. Starting mitigation: reduce batching on latency-sensitive routes and route some traffic to canary region.

sam k: Notifying support. Preliminary customer impact: two accounts reported slow responses; monitoring shows ~1.2% requests >3s and ~0.4% error rate spike for embeddings endpoints.

maria chu: Mitigation executed: set max_batch_tokens=256 and disabled large-batch pooling for low-latency routes. p95 observed drop to ~900ms. Continuing to monitor.

alisha r: Found repeated log pattern — KV cache eviction storm around 16:21 UTC. Snippet:
```
2026-03-15T16:21:14Z model=redwood-v1 instance=gpu-12 kv_cache_miss=1248 evict_thr=1024
2026-03-15T16:21:15Z model=redwood-v1 instance=gpu-12 mem_pressure=0.82 batch_size=128
```

maria chu: Good, saving to evidence store and adding to bridge notes. Evidence bucket: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/INC-2026-3247/

jon p: I'll draft the event timeline and attach logs. Who owns the RCA?

maria chu: I'll own triage and the initial RCA draft. @pm-ash can you schedule a postmortem review for tomorrow 15:00 UTC?

pm-ash: Created invite: "INC-2026-3247 PM Review" 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Invites sent to @maria_chu @jon_p @alisha_r @irene_t @sam_k.

irene t: Action items (assigned): 1) RCA draft (maria) 2) KV cache thresholds review (jon) 3) autoscaler stabilization and restart root cause (alisha) 4) customer comms follow-up (sam). I'll add these to the remediation board.

maria chu: Drafting RCA now — includes timeline, contributing factors, impact summary, and mitigations. Draft uploaded to docs/incidents/INC-2026-3247/rca-draft.md

jon p: Note: fallback model mapping caused shorter outputs for some requests — include as contributing factor and potential UX risk.

sam k: Sent initial customer notice to affected accounts with apology and mitigation summary.

maria chu: Draft uploaded. Timeline summary for the doc: "16:19 detection; 16:20 autoscaler triggered; 16:21 KV cache miss storm; 16:24 mitigation applied; 16:30 p95 recovered."

paul-sre-bot: Auto-assign: rca-draft assigned to @maria_chu. Reminder: 72h to sign-off or escalate.

maria chu: Requesting peer review from @jon_p and @irene_t — please comment on timeline and proposed mitigations by EOD.

jon p: Reviewing now. Small nits: clarify mem_pressure is node-level, include full autoscaler error block and exact restart messages.

irene t: LGTM overall. Suggest adding an eviction-threshold tuning playbook and a QA rollout plan for cache parameter changes.

maria chu: Incorporated feedback and updated draft. Added rollback-safe config snippet and QA checklist.

maria chu: ```yaml
kv_cache:
  eviction_threshold: 0.75
  max_entries: 200000
  monitor: true
```

pm-ash: Postmortem review scheduled. @legal-bot recommends removing any PII from shared evidence. Please scrub examples.

maria chu: Logs scrubbed for PII, left aggregated metrics and sanitized traces. Ready for final review.

irene t: Sign-off from infra and runtime leads: @jon_p and @alisha_r acknowledged readiness.

jon p: Reviewed and approved. :thumbsup:

sam k: Customer follow-ups completed, closing loop with support tickets.

maria chu: RCA finalized and signed off by leads. Moving action items to remediation board and scheduling follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3247 status changed to RESOLVED. Postmortem link: docs/incidents/INC-2026-3247/postmortem.md
